name: vscode-hover-block-dimmer
description: Keep the hovered or active code block at full brightness while dimming or blurring surrounding lines.

commands.title: HoverBlock Dimmer: Toggle Mouse Hover Detection (On / Off)
HoverBlock Dimmer: Open Settings Menu (Effect / Trigger / Scope)
HoverBlock Dimmer: Switch Effect Style (Dim+Blur / Dim Only / Blur Only / Gradient)
HoverBlock Dimmer: Switch Trigger Mode (Cursor + Mouse Hover / Mouse Hover Only / Cursor Only)
HoverBlock Dimmer: Switch Focus Scope (1 Line / Paragraph / Code Block)
HoverBlock Dimmer: Apply Intensity Preset (2-Tier Block Dim / Subtle / Deep Dim+Blur)

hoverBlockDimmer.enabled.description: Enable or disable HoverBlock Dimmer line/block dimming and blur.

enumDescriptions: Track cursor/selection position only (recommended, lowest CPU usage — mouse hover disabled).
Track both cursor/selection movement and mouse hover over lines.
Track mouse hover over lines only (via VS Code hover events).
hoverBlockDimmer.triggerMode.description: Whether the focused line/block tracks cursor movement only, mouse hover, or both.

enumDescriptions: Focus on 1 line (or the active multi-line selection).
Focus on the contiguous non-empty paragraph around the active line.
Focus on the enclosing indentation code block.
hoverBlockDimmer.focusScope.description: How much code around the anchor line stays in clear focus.

hoverBlockDimmer.contextLines.description: Extra lines above and below the focused line to keep clear (also used as fallback padding when a block is 1 line).

hoverBlockDimmer.maxBlockLines.description: Maximum lines a detected code block can span before falling back to local paragraph or context lines.

hoverBlockDimmer.nearLines.description: Number of slightly dimmed transition lines (nearDecoration) immediately above and below the focused block.

hoverBlockDimmer.nearOpacity.description: Opacity of the transition lines (nearDecoration) immediately bordering the focused block.

enumDescriptions: Dim opacity and apply CSS blur filter to unfocused lines.
Reduce opacity of unfocused lines without blurring (nearDecoration + dimDecoration).
Apply CSS blur filter to unfocused lines without dimming opacity.
Gradually increase dimming and blur across near, mid, and far bands.
hoverBlockDimmer.effectStyle.description: How unfocused lines are visually styled.

hoverBlockDimmer.dimOpacity.description: Opacity of outer strongly dimmed lines (dimDecoration; 0.05 = very faint, 0.95 = barely dimmed).

hoverBlockDimmer.blurAmountPx.description: Blur filter radius in pixels applied when blur is enabled.

hoverBlockDimmer.highlightFocusedLine.description: Add a subtle spotlight background and left accent border on the focused line(s).

hoverBlockDimmer.focusedLineBackground.description: Background color of the focused spotlight line(s).

hoverBlockDimmer.focusedLineBorderColor.description: Left border color of the focused spotlight line(s).
